sarah-partners: Quick sync — putting together a short sprint to triage QBR action items, tier updates, and the MDF runway for marketplace & HW partners. Can folks chime in with must-do items today?

 diego-pm: +1. Key thing: finalize QBR scorecard metrics we promised to partners. I have a draft KPI list.

 maya-ops: I'll pull the current tier nomination backlog and outstanding partner evidence.

 jon-sales: Need to confirm co-marketing credit ceilings for two pipeline deals (APAC infra partner + SI). Can we lock budgets?

 eva-fp&a: I can surface the remaining MDF balance. Quick FYI: ~ $120k left unallocated across Q3 commitments.

 nate-si: From SI side — integration playbook needs a checklist for joint announcements. I can draft but need the release windows.

 sarah-partners: Awesome. Outcome for today: 1) agree scorecard KPIs 2) confirm MDF allocation for the two deals 3) create announcement playbook draft. Who wants which?

 diego-pm: I can own the scorecard KPIs. Will post a short table in an hour.

 jon-sales: I'll take the MDF reconciliation for the APAC deal. Tagging @eva-fp&a for numbers.

 eva-fp&a: Assigned. I'll DM the ledger and cc the finance folder link: https://okta.company/finance/partner-mdf-q3

 nate-si: I'll start the announcement checklist. Can someone share the standard legal/copy checklist? Last time it tripped us up.

 maya-ops: Copy checklist is in the partner playbooks drive, but i'll paste a minimal version here:
```
- partner logo approval
- joint press embargo date
- messaging owner
- customer references cleared
- tech integration call scheduled
- launch assets list (blog, decks, demo videos)
```

 sarah-partners: Perfect, thanks. Diego — when you post KPIs, include pass/fail thresholds and data owners.

 diego-pm: Will do. Tentative KPIs: partner-sourced ARR, marketplace listing installs, joint demo conversion, time-to-integration (avg). Owners: Jon, Sarah, Nate, Maya.

 jon-sales: For the APAC partner, we also need a minor MDF uplift for local events. Estimated $18k. @eva-fp&a ok?

 eva-fp&a: We can reallocate $18k if we deprioritize a marketing pilot. I'll list tradeoffs in the ledger.

 nate-si: For the announcement playbook, recommend we add a short technical readiness signoff from eng-platform. @maya-ops can you loop them in?

 maya-ops: Looping @eng-platform in the PM. I'll create a short ticket and ping them.

 ops-bot: Reminder: QBR pack deadline in 6 business days. Attachments due by EOD Friday.

 sarah-partners: Thanks everyone. Last ask: can we schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize allocations? 10:30 PT?

 diego-pm: Works for me.

 jon-sales: Works.

 eva-fp&a: I can do 10:30.

 nate-si: I can make it.

 maya-ops: Confirmed.

 sarah-partners: Great — I'll send the calendar invite and drop the meeting agenda in the doc. Agenda items: KPI signoff, MDF allocation, announcement playbook owner and timeline.

 jon-sales: One more: should we include a short partner tier adjustment proposal? small shift to promote SI with certified integrations.

 diego-pm: Add as a discussion item — we'll table formal changes to the following week but discuss the case.

 sarah-partners: Noted. Thanks team — see you 10:30 PT. :rocket: 

 maya-ops: Adding a follow-up action list to the doc after the meeting.

 ops-bot: Event created: QBR-PartnerOps-Sprint 10:30 PT tomorrow. Organizer: sarah-partners.
